prompts.cheer:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent 2x2 animation sprite atlas for the existing standalone desktop pet.
Input image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY and rendering-style reference only. Preserve the exact cute chibi blue curly hair, blue eyes, whale hood/head fins, whale tail, navy/white palette and polished soft cel-painted linework. One character in each of four frames.
Composition: A square transparent PNG containing exactly FOUR equal square cells, 2 columns x 2 rows, in row-major animation order. Draw the entire character in every cell including shoes, tail and all props. Keep each figure comfortably inside its own cell with transparent gutters (at least 8% of cell width on every side), feet aligned at 90% of each cell height, head centered at 50% of cell width. Same character scale, same head center and same foot baseline across frames; keep the head/body nearly still, animate primarily hands/face/props. No frame dividers, no labels, no letters, no background, no scenery, no extra people, no floor or cast-shadow patch. Real transparent alpha. Props must stay above the shoes' baseline. Figures must not touch or overlap neighboring cells. This is an actual usable animation sheet, not an illustration collage.
Primary request: turn this whale pet into a cheerful cheerleader. She wears a modest cute navy/white cheer uniform with whale motif, blue short pleated skirt over opaque shorts/leggings and blue sneakers, keeping the whale hood and tail. Holds a fluffy blue and a fluffy white pom-pom. Four loop frames: (0) both pompoms at shoulder height, smiling; (1) left pompom raised overhead, right near shoulder, slight excited lean; (2) both at shoulder level, eyes closed with delighted smile, small knee bend; (3) right pompom raised overhead, left near shoulder, return towards frame0. The outfit must be consistent across all four images. Full body and both pompoms remain inside the cell, don't draw jump-induced vertical translation; easy cheerful arm motion at a fixed body anchor.
